license_required.quote: Practicing dentistry or dental hygiene unless the person has an appropriate, active license issued by the department pursuant to this chapter.

issuing_authority.value: Board of Dentistry / Department of Health
issuing_authority.quote: The department shall license an applicant who the board certifies meets all of the following criteria

age_minimum.quote: Is 18 years of age or older.

degree_required.value: D.D.S. or D.M.D. from an accredited dental school
degree_required.quote: Is a graduate of a dental school accredited by the American Dental Association Commission on Dental Accreditation or its successor entity, if any, or any other dental accrediting entity recognized by the United States Department of Education

accrediting_body.value: American Dental Association Commission on Dental Accreditation
accrediting_body.quote: Is a graduate of a dental school accredited by the American Dental Association Commission on Dental Accreditation or its successor entity, if any, or any other dental accrediting entity recognized by the United States Department of Education

exams.name: Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations (written/national board)
exams.notes: Written examination administered by the Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations or its successor organization
exams.quote: Has successfully completed the examination administered by the Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations or its successor organization.

exams.name: American Dental Licensing Examination (ADLEX) – practical/clinical
exams.notes: Produced by the American Board of Dental Examiners, Inc.; must be the ADLEX administered in this state or an out-of-state ADLEX score accepted under specified conditions
exams.quote: A practical or clinical examination, which must be the American Dental Licensing Examination produced by the American Board of Dental Examiners, Inc., or its successor entity, if any

exams.name: Florida laws and rules examination
exams.notes: Written examination on the laws and rules of the state regulating the practice of dentistry
exams.quote: A written examination on the laws and rules of the state regulating the practice of dentistry.

interval_years.quote: The department shall adopt rules establishing a procedure for the biennial renewal of licenses.

required.quote: each licensed dentist shall be required to complete biennially not less than 30 hours of continuing professional education in dental subjects

hours_per_period.quote: complete biennially not less than 30 hours of continuing professional education in dental subjects

period_years.quote: complete biennially not less than 30 hours of continuing professional education in dental subjects

value: minimum of 2 hours on safe and effective prescribing of controlled substances
subjects pertinent to oral health and safety
up to 3 hours of practice management course (optional)
topical_requirements.quote: with a minimum of 2 hours of continuing education on the safe and effective prescribing of controlled substances

available.quote: an applicant may submit scores from an American Dental Licensing Examination previously administered in a jurisdiction other than this state after October 1, 2011, and such examination results are recognized as valid for the purpose of licensure in this state

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a valid active dental license in good standing with no restrictions from another U.S. state/territory, have been in full-time practice (minimum 1,200 hours/year) for 5 consecutive years, pass the Florida laws and rules exam, complete equivalent continuing education, and meet other criteria including no felony/misdemeanor convictions related to health care practice.
requirements.quote: The applicant currently possesses a valid and active dental license in good standing, with no restriction, which has never been revoked, suspended, restricted, or otherwise disciplined, from another state or territory of the United States

regulatory_model.quote: Practicing dentistry or dental hygiene unless the person has an appropriate, active license issued by the department pursuant to this chapter.

credential_type.quote: The department shall license an applicant who the board certifies meets all of the following criteria

is_mandatory.quote: Practicing dentistry or dental hygiene unless the person has an appropriate, active license issued by the department pursuant to this chapter.

title_protection.quote: Using the name or title "dentist," the letters "D.D.S." or "D.M.D.", or any other words, letters, title, or descriptive matter which in any way represents a person as being able to diagnose, treat, prescribe, or operate for any disease, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury, or physical condition of the teeth or jaws or oral-maxillofacial region unless the person has an active dentist's license issued by the department pursuant to this chapter.

scope_protection.quote: Practicing dentistry or dental hygiene unless the person has an appropriate, active license issued by the department pursuant to this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to obtain, obtain, or renew a license by bribery, fraudulent misrepresentation, or through an error of the department or board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempting to obtain, obtaining, or renewing a license under this chapter by bribery, fraudulent misrepresentations, or through an error of the department or the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license to practice dentistry or dental hygiene revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against by the licensing authority of another state, territory, or country.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a license to practice dentistry or dental hygiene revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against, including the denial of licensure, by the licensing authority of another state, territory, or country.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of or entering a plea of nolo contendere to a crime in any jurisdiction which relates to the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty of or entering a plea of nolo contendere to, regardless of adjudication, a crime in any jurisdiction which relates to the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising goods or services in a manner which is fraudulent, false, deceptive, or misleading contrary to s. 466.019 or board rules.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising goods or services in a manner which is fraudulent, false, deceptive, or misleading in form or content contrary to s. 466.019 or rules of the board adopted pursuant thereto.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising, practicing, or attempting to practice under a name other than one's own.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising, practicing, or attempting to practice under a name other than one's own.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report to the department any person who the licensee knows or has reason to believe is clearly in violation of this chapter or the rules.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the department any person who the licensee knows, or has reason to believe, is clearly in violation of this chapter or of the rules of the department or the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding, assisting, procuring, or advising any unlicensed person to practice dentistry or dental hygiene.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding, assisting, procuring, or advising any unlicensed person to practice dentistry or dental hygiene contrary to this chapter or to a rule of the department or the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being employed by any corporation, organization, group, or person other than a dentist or a professional corporation or limited liability company composed of dentists to practice dentistry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being employed by any corporation, organization, group, or person other than a dentist or a professional corporation or limited liability company composed of dentists to practice dentistry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to perform any statutory or legal obligation placed upon a licensee.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to perform any statutory or legal obligation placed upon a licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or filing a report which the licensee knows to be false, or failing to file a required report or record.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or filing a report which the licensee knows to be false, failing to file a report or record required by state or federal law, knowingly impeding or obstructing such filing or inducing another person to do so.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing any act constituting sexual battery upon a patient or intentionally touching the sexual organ of a patient.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing any act which would constitute sexual battery, as defined in chapter 794, upon a patient or intentionally touching the sexual organ of a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representations in or related to the practice of dentistry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representations in or related to the practice of dentistry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to keep written dental records and medical history records justifying the course of treatment of the patient.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to keep written dental records and medical history records justifying the course of treatment of the patient including, but not limited to, patient histories, examination results, test results, and X rays, if taken.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to make available to a patient or client copies of documents in the possession or under control of the licensee which relate to the patient.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to make available to a patient or client, or to her or his legal representative or to the department if authorized in writing by the patient, copies of documents in the possession or under control of the licensee which relate to the patient or client.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing professional services which have not been duly authorized by the patient or client or their legal representative.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing professional services which have not been duly authorized by the patient or client, or her or his legal representative, except as provided in ss. 766.103 and 768.13.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, procuring, dispensing, administering, mixing, or otherwise preparing a legend drug, including any controlled substance, other than in the course of professional practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, procuring, dispensing, administering, mixing, or otherwise preparing a legend drug, including any controlled substance, other than in the course of the professional practice of the dentist.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, procuring, dispensing, or administering any Schedule drug to oneself except as prescribed by another authorized practitioner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, procuring, dispensing, or administering any medicinal drug appearing on any schedule set forth in chapter 893, by a dentist to herself or himself, except those prescribed, dispensed, or administered to the dentist by another practitioner authorized to prescribe them.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness or use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or any other type of material or as a result of any mental or physical condition.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being unable to practice her or his profession with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness or use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or any other type of material or as a result of any mental or physical condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing fraud, deceit, or misconduct in the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing fraud, deceit, or misconduct in the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide and maintain reasonable sanitary facilities and conditions.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to provide and maintain reasonable sanitary facilities and conditions.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide adequate radiation safeguards.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to provide adequate radiation safeguards.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing any procedure or prescribing any therapy which constitutes experimentation on human subjects without full, informed, and written consent.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing any procedure or prescribing any therapy which, by the prevailing standards of dental practice in the community, would constitute experimentation on human subjects, without first obtaining full, informed, and written consent.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being guilty of incompetence or negligence by failing to meet the minimum standards of performance in diagnosis and treatment when measured against generally prevailing peer performance, including dental malpractice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being guilty of incompetence or negligence by failing to meet the minimum standards of performance in diagnosis and treatment when measured against generally prevailing peer performance, including, but not limited to, the undertaking of diagnosis and treatment for which the dentist is not qualified by training or experience or being guilty of dental malpractice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law or accepting and performing professional responsibilities the licensee is not competent to perform.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law or accepting and performing professional responsibilities which the licensee knows or has reason to know that she or he is not competent to perform.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegating professional responsibilities to a person who is not qualified by training, experience, or licensure to perform them.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Delegating professional responsibilities to a person who is not qualified by training, experience, or licensure to perform them.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating a lawful order of the board or department previously entered in a disciplinary hearing, or failure to comply with a lawfully issued subpoena.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating a lawful order of the board or department previously entered in a disciplinary hearing; or failure to comply with a lawfully issued subpoena of the board or department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being adjudged mentally incompetent in this or any other state.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being adjudged mentally incompetent in this or any other state, the discipline for which shall last only so long as the adjudication.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Presigning blank prescription or laboratory work order forms.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Presigning blank prescription or laboratory work order forms.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, ordering, dispensing, administering, supplying, selling, or giving growth hormones, testosterone or its analogs, HCG, or other hormones for the purpose of muscle building or to enhance athletic performance.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, ordering, dispensing, administering, supplying, selling, or giving growth hormones, testosterone or its analogs, human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG), or other hormones for the purpose of muscle building or to enhance athletic performance.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Operating or causing to be operated a dental office in a manner resulting in dental treatment below minimum acceptable standards of performance for the community.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Operating or causing to be operated a dental office in such a manner as to result in dental treatment that is below minimum acceptable standards of performance for the community.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering anesthesia in a manner which violates rules of the board adopted pursuant to s. 466.017.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering anesthesia in a manner which violates rules of the board adopted pursuant to s. 466.017.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Allowing any person other than another dentist or a professional corporation or LLC composed of dentists to direct, control, or interfere with a dentist's clinical judgment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Allowing any person other than another dentist or a professional corporation or limited liability company composed of dentists to direct, control, or interfere with a dentist's clinical judgment

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing deceptive or fraudulent expert witness testimony related to the practice of dentistry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Providing deceptive or fraudulent expert witness testimony related to the practice of dentistry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to perform an in-person examination or obtain records from an in-person examination within the last 12 months before initial diagnosis and correction of malposition of teeth or initial use of an orthodontic appliance.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing by the dentist of record, before the initial diagnosis and correction of a malposition of human teeth or initial use of an orthodontic appliance, to perform an in-person examination of the patient or obtain records from an in-person examination within the last 12 months

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide each patient with the name, contact telephone number, after-hours contact information for emergencies, and license information of each dentist providing dental services.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to provide each patient with the name, contact telephone number, after-hours contact information for emergencies, and license information of each dentist who is providing dental services to the patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising specialty services in violation of this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising specialty services in violation of this chapter.

definition_quote.value: Dentistry means the healing art which is concerned with the examination, diagnosis, treatment planning, and care of conditions within the human oral cavity and its adjacent tissues and structures. It includes the performance or attempted performance of any dental operation, or oral or oral-maxillofacial surgery and any procedures adjunct thereto, including physical evaluation directly related to such operation or surgery pursuant to hospital rules and regulations. It also includes dental service of any kind gratuitously or for any remuneration paid, or to be paid, directly or indirectly, to any person or agency.
definition_quote.quote: "Dentistry" means the healing art which is concerned with the examination, diagnosis, treatment planning, and care of conditions within the human oral cavity and its adjacent tissues and structures.

value: examination and diagnosis of conditions within the human oral cavity and adjacent tissues
treatment planning and care of oral conditions
dental operations and oral or oral-maxillofacial surgery
taking impressions of human teeth or jaws
supplying artificial substitutes for natural teeth; constructing, reproducing, or repairing prosthetic dentures, bridges, appliances
placing, adjusting appliances or structures in the human mouth
diagnosing, prescribing, or treating disease, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury, or physical condition of the human teeth or jaws or oral-maxillofacial region
correcting malformations of teeth or jaws
performing surgical operations within scope of practice and training
administering general or local anesthesia or sedation
methods_authorized.quote: It includes the performance or attempted performance of any dental operation, or oral or oral-maxillofacial surgery and any procedures adjunct thereto

drug_authority.value: A dentist shall have the right to prescribe drugs or medicine, subject to limitations imposed by law; perform surgical operations within the scope of her or his practice and training; administer general or local anesthesia or sedation, subject to limitations imposed by law.
drug_authority.quote: A dentist shall have the right to prescribe drugs or medicine, subject to limitations imposed by law; perform surgical operations within the scope of her or his practice and training; administer general or local anesthesia or sedation, subject to limitations imposed by law

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: any mortality that occurs during or as the result of a dental procedure, or an incident that results in a temporary or permanent physical or mental injury that requires hospitalization or emergency room treatment of a dental patient which occurs during or as a direct result of the use of general anesthesia, deep sedation, moderate sedation, pediatric moderate sedation, oral sedation, minimal sedation (anxiolysis), nitrous oxide, or local anesthesia.

sedation_permit_onsite_inspection_requir.quote: Establish an administrative mechanism enabling the board to verify compliance with training, education, experience, equipment, or certification requirements of dentists, dental hygienists, and dental assistants adopted pursuant to this subsection. The board may charge a fee to defray the cost of verifying compliance with requirements adopted pursuant to this paragraph.

sedation_adverse_event_reporting_require.quote: Any adverse incident that occurs in an office maintained by a dentist must be reported to the department. The required notification to the department must be submitted in writing by certified mail and postmarked within 48 hours after the incident occurs.

specialist_license_available.quote: A dentist licensed under this chapter may not hold himself or herself out as a specialist, or advertise membership in or specialty recognition by an accrediting organization, unless the dentist: (a) Has completed a specialty education program approved by the American Dental Association and the Commission on Dental Accreditation

specialty_advertising_disclaimer_require.quote: a dentist who lacks membership in or certification, diplomate status, or other similar credentials from an accrediting organization approved as bona fide by either the American Dental Association or the board may announce a practice emphasis in any other area of dental practice if the dentist incorporates in capital letters or some other manner clearly distinguishable from the rest of the announcement, solicitation, or advertisement the following statement

value: no supervision (for specified tasks in health access settings)
dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: "Direct supervision" means supervision whereby a dentist diagnoses the condition to be treated, a dentist authorizes the procedure to be performed, a dentist remains on the premises while the procedures are performed, and a dentist approves the work performed before dismissal of the patient.

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: A dental hygienist licensed in this state may perform the following remediable tasks in a health access setting as defined in s. 466.003 without the physical presence, prior examination, or authorization of a dentist

value: patients in health access settings (Department of Children and Families programs, Department of Health programs, Department of Juvenile Justice programs, nonprofit community health centers, Head Start centers, federally qualified health centers, school-based prevention programs, clinics operated by accredited colleges of dentistry, accredited dental hygiene programs)
advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: "Health access setting" means a program or an institution of the Department of Children and Families, the Department of Health, the Department of Juvenile Justice, a nonprofit community health center, a Head Start center, a federally qualified health center or look-alike as defined by federal law, a school-based prevention program, a clinic operated by an accredited college of dentistry, or an accredited dental hygiene program in this state

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: No person other than a dentist licensed pursuant to this chapter, nor any entity other than a professional corporation or limited liability company composed of dentists, may: (a) Employ a dentist or dental hygienist in the operation of a dental office.

opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: For the treatment of acute pain, a prescription for an opioid drug listed as a Schedule II controlled substance in s. 893.03 or 21 U.S.C. s. 812 may not exceed a 3-day supply

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: The Department of Health shall establish a practitioner profile for dentists licensed under this chapter for a practitioner's designation as a controlled substance prescribing practitioner as provided in s. 456.44.

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: Each licensed dentist who uses the services of any dental laboratory for the purpose of constructing, altering, repairing, or duplicating any denture, implant, veneer, partial denture, bridge splint, orthodontic or other prosthetic appliance, or other suitable form of artificial oral restorative device shall be required to furnish the dental laboratory with a written prescription in a form prescribed by rule of the board.

teledentistry_authorized.quote: An advertisement of dental services provided through telehealth as defined in s. 456.47(1) must include a disclaimer

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: Any dental hygienist seeking a certificate to administer local anesthesia must apply to the department, remit an application fee, and submit proof of successful completion of a course in the administration of local anesthesia pursuant to subsection (5). The board shall certify, and the department shall issue a certificate to, any dental hygienist who fulfills the qualifications of subsection (5).

patient_record_retention_years.quote: All patient records kept in accordance with this section shall be maintained for a period of 4 years from the date of the patient's last appointment.

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: A dentist or dental hygienist who administers or employs the use of any form of anesthesia must possess a certification in either basic cardiopulmonary resuscitation for health professionals or advanced cardiac life support approved by the American Heart Association or the American Red Cross or an equivalent agency-sponsored course with recertification every 2 years.
